svg.title: What changed between the two classroom activities?
svg.desc: First discussion: Students criticised how a platform had treated its users.. Later design task: The groups proposed collecting information for recommendations.. Teaching problem: Concern in the first discussion did not transfer to design decisions.

g.text: What changed between the two classroom activities?
Students criticised how a platform had treated its users.
The groups proposed collecting information for recommendations.
Concern in the first discussion did not transfer to design decisions.
